tb21_profile.skill: Diff two circular plasmid sequences to locate the edit, then design back-to-back Q5 site-directed-mutagenesis primer pairs whose 5' tails carry the insert and whose annealing regions satisfy length 15-45, Tm 58-72 and pair delta<=5 as measured by primer3 oligotm
tb21_profile.domain: Molecular biology / synthetic biology: FASTA plasmids, PCR primer design, site-directed mutagenesis, nearest-neighbour Tm thermodynamics
tb21_profile.task_form: implement-from-spec / design-an-artifact-satisfying-a-rule-set with an external CLI as ground truth and an exact FASTA output format

searches: tools.py search all "primer3|oligotm|melting temperature|Tm of|reverse complement"
tools.py search smith "alignment|Levenshtein|edit distance|longest common subsequence|similarity|reverse the|string2string|textdistance"

notes: Near-duplicate of dna-assembly, so the pools overlap heavily; the distinguishing sub-skill here is diffing the input plasmid against the desired output to locate the edit, which is why I added deepdiff, gendiff (tw_678582) and cogent3 k-mer/dotplot candidates that the lexical retrievers missed. SWE-Smith contains zero biology across its 119 repos; its 10 are honest 1-2s. SWE-Rebench has only three cogent3 tasks; ranks 5-10 are scientific-correctness stand-ins and are filler. Several ids here (tw_48144, tw_327279, cogent3-*, openmdao-2744, deepdiff, string2string) came from my own searches rather than the dna-insert shortlist.
